description: Explore dashboard ('/explore') redesign — desktop pass. Reskins Dashboard, MapShell, MapView, PriorityPanel, LoadingSteps, ZoneDetails, ImpactComparison, ExploreGuide. Adds a module-scope useIsDesktop hook (iteration-3 NIT #5 — subscribe/getSnapshot bound once), a Dashboard-level hoveredCellId state (iteration-1 finding #2), an OsmStatus writer effect + unmount reset (iteration-1 findings #5, #14), the Skeleton restyle that paints a solid #e3eadf under prefers-reduced-motion (iteration-2 HIGH #1), the PRIORITY_CHROME_HEX hex-mirror constant in MapView (iteration-1 finding #13), a dashed hovered-cell outline polygon in MapView wrapped in useDeferredValue, and a filter/sort toolbar in PriorityPanel using two <SegmentedControl> instances. The mobile tab branching is intentionally deferred to FEAT-004 — this feature renders only the desktop grid. Depends on FEAT-001 (SegmentedControl, OsmStatusContext, design tokens) and FEAT-002 (which already restyled the landing page but is independent of this feature's changes).
steps: In src/components/Dashboard.tsx, expand the top-of-file React import list to include `useRef, useSyncExternalStore` alongside the existing `useCallback, useDeferredValue, useEffect, useMemo, useState`. Add `import { useOsmStatus } from "@/components/OsmStatusContext";` (iteration-3 NIT #6 import-diff). Keep every other import unchanged.

Still in Dashboard.tsx, add a module-scope hook ABOVE the exported `Dashboard` component (iteration-3 NIT #5): declare `const subscribe = (cb: () => void) => { const mql = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 768px)"); mql.addEventListener("change", cb); return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", cb); };` and `const getSnapshot = () => window.matchMedia("(min-width: 768px)").matches;` and `const getServerSnap = () => true;` all at module scope, then `function useIsDesktop() { return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnap); }`. These must NOT be re-declared inside Dashboard's body on every render.

Inside the Dashboard component body, add two new states near the existing `selection` state: `const [hoveredCellId, setHoveredCellId] = useState<string | null>(null);` and destructure `const { set: setOsmStatus } = useOsmStatus();`. Preserve every existing state hook, memo, callback, and useEffect verbatim.

Add the OsmStatus writer effect to Dashboard.tsx: `useEffect(() => { if (load.status === "error") setOsmStatus("error"); else if (load.status === "loading" || scoring) setOsmStatus("streaming"); else setOsmStatus("ready"); }, [load.status, scoring, setOsmStatus]);`. Then add the unmount reset: `useEffect(() => () => setOsmStatus("idle"), [setOsmStatus]);` (iteration-1 finding #14).

Replace the inline `
...
` block (brand, label, status, Change-area CTA) with a compact page-summary row: `

Greening priorities

{label}

{area.sizeKm} × {area.sizeKm} km · {formatCenter(area.center)}

`.

Change the root element of Dashboard.tsx from `<main className="mx-auto min-h-screen max-w-[1600px] px-4 py-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 lg:py-6">` to `<div className="mx-auto min-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] max-w-[1600px] px-4 py-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 lg:py-6">` (iteration-1 finding #3).

Update the Skeleton helper in Dashboard.tsx to `function Skeleton({ className }: { className: string }) { return <span className={\`block rounded-lg bg-[#e3eadf] animate-shimmer ${className}\`} aria-hidden="true" />; }` so reduced-motion users see the solid #e3eadf fallback (iteration-2 HIGH #1 / iteration-1 NIT #9).

Restyle the metric cards grid in Dashboard.tsx: each card becomes `<article className=\`relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-[var(--color-surface-glass)] backdrop-blur border border-[var(--line)] shadow-[var(--shadow-glass-md)] p-5 before:absolute before:inset-y-4 before:left-0 before:w-1 before:rounded-full before:bg-gradient-to-b before:from-[var(--green)] before:to-[var(--lime)] motion-safe:animate-slide-up delay-${d}\`>` with d cycled through 100 / 200 / 300 / 400. Include an inline 20px `<svg aria-hidden="true">` icon per card (trees/grid/pin). Keep every expression (`metric.value`, `metric.detail`, `top`, `priorityBand(top.priority).color`, `scoredCount`, `schools`, `hospitals`) and the top-priority button's `onClick={() => selectCell(top.id)}` verbatim. Add `motion-safe:animate-pop-in` keyed on `top?.id` for the top-priority score chip when `top` first exists.

In Dashboard.tsx, extract the layer-toggle chip row into an inline `function LayerDock({ mode, layersOn, setLayersOn, ready }: { mode: 'floating' | 'strip'; ... })` sub-component colocated in the same file. `mode='floating'` renders a `absolute top-4 right-4 z-[500] glass-panel rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-[var(--shadow-glass-md)]` panel with each row showing a swatch, label, and a 36x20 toggle switch (`role="switch" aria-checked={on}` with a sliding knob). `mode='strip'` renders the current horizontal chip layout but with `min-h-11` touch targets per chip. Preserve `LAYER_TOGGLES`, `layersOn`, `setLayersOn`, `disabled={!ready}`, and `aria-pressed` verbatim. Render `<LayerDock mode="floating" ... />` inside the map `<section>` as a positioned overlay.

Upgrade the map `<section>` chrome in Dashboard.tsx to `className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-[32px] border border-white/80 bg-white shadow-[var(--shadow-glass-lg)]"`. In the error branch, restyle the alert panel as `glass-panel bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_30%_20%,rgba(239,68,68,0.08),transparent_60%)]` while keeping the 'Try again' / 'Pick another area' copy and handlers (`retry`, `<Link href="/">`). Pass new props to `<PriorityPanel>` in the aside: `hoveredCellId={hoveredCellId}` and `onHoverCell={setHoveredCellId}`.

Trim the inline `<footer className="mt-3 space-y-1 px-2 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--muted)]">` in Dashboard.tsx: drop the `© OpenStreetMap contributors` phrase (now owned by the global <Footer /> — iteration-1 finding #16). Keep only `metadata.source`, `metadata.fetchedAt`, and the `ranking.notes.map(...)` list; wrap in a thin `glass-panel rounded-2xl p-3`. The desktop `<aside>` retains `md:sticky md:top-20 md:max-h-[calc(100vh-6rem)] md:overflow-y-auto`.

Edit src/components/MapView.tsx: expand the React import to `import { useDeferredValue, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";` (iteration-2 NIT #7). Add `hoveredCellId?: string | null;` to `MapViewProps` and destructure it from the component props. Add a module-level constant above the component: `const PRIORITY_CHROME_HEX = { critical: "#c62f2f", moderate: "#f2a93b", lower: "#7fb87f" } as const;` and helper `function groupedChrome(level: PriorityLevel): string | null { if (level === "very-high" || level === "high") return PRIORITY_CHROME_HEX.critical; if (level === "moderate") return PRIORITY_CHROME_HEX.moderate; if (level === "low" || level === "very-low") return PRIORITY_CHROME_HEX.lower; return null; }` (iteration-1 finding #13). Import `PriorityLevel` from `@/types` only if it is already exported there — if not, locally derive it from `RankedCell["priority"]`.

In MapView.tsx, inside the component body (after the existing `selected` lookup), add `const deferredHovered = useDeferredValue(hoveredCellId ?? null); const hoveredCell = useMemo(() => (deferredHovered ? cells.find((c) => c.id === deferredHovered) ?? null : null), [deferredHovered, cells]);`. Render exactly one additional `<Polygon>` just after the existing selected-cell outline polygon: `{hoveredCell && hoveredCell.id !== selectedCellId && (<Polygon positions={hoveredCell.geometry.coordinates[0].map((p) => toLatLng(p as [number, number]))} pathOptions={{ color: groupedChrome(hoveredCell.priority) ?? "#123e2a", weight: 2, dashArray: "4 4", fill: false, interactive: false }} />)}`. Do NOT change the existing selected outline polygon, grid polygons, GeoJSON overlays, scenario polygon, facility markers, tooltips, PanToSelection, ZoomControl, or MapContainer props.

In MapView.tsx, restyle the hint pill overlay: keep its content, `aria-live="polite"`, and the `{hint.title} / {hint.body}` branching logic verbatim; swap classes to include `rounded-2xl shadow-[var(--shadow-glass-lg)] motion-safe:animate-fade-in`. Restyle the legend dock to use `.glass-panel rounded-2xl shadow-[var(--shadow-glass-md)]`; keep the `legendOpen` toggle, chevron rotation, and `PRIORITY_BANDS.map(...)` list exactly.

Edit src/components/MapShell.tsx to update ONLY the dynamic-import `loading` fallback element to `() =>
Drawing the priority map…
`. Leave the `dynamic(() => import(...), { ssr: false, loading: ... })` call shape, the component prop forwarding, and the export unchanged. Because MapViewProps gained `hoveredCellId?`, MapShell automatically forwards it.

Edit src/components/PriorityPanel.tsx: expand the component props to include `hoveredCellId?: string | null;` and `onHoverCell?: (id: string | null) => void;`. On each row's outer button, call `onHoverCell?.(cell.id)` from `onMouseEnter` and `onFocus`, and `onHoverCell?.(null)` from `onMouseLeave` and `onBlur` (iteration-1 finding #2). Add a 4px left accent bar colored by priority — `.accent-bar-critical` for `very-high | high`, `.accent-bar-moderate` for `moderate`, `.accent-bar-lower` for `low | very-low`, and no bar for `unscored`. The score chip color must continue to come from `priorityBand(cell.priority).color` (do not substitute).

In PriorityPanel.tsx, add a filter/sort toolbar above the `<ol>` using two `<SegmentedControl>` instances imported from `@/components/SegmentedControl`: filter uses `options={["all", "critical", "moderate"] as const}`, default `"all"`, `ariaLabel="Filter priority rows"`, `renderOption={(v) => v === "all" ? "All" : v === "critical" ? "Critical" : "Moderate"}`; sort uses `options={["rank", "score"] as const}`, default `"rank"`, `ariaLabel="Sort order"`, `renderOption={(v) => v === "rank" ? "By rank" : "By score"}`. Apply filter + sort via a local `useMemo` over the already-ranked `cells` prop — do not re-score. The `limit` prop still caps display. Set the `<ol>` wrapper to `overflow-y-auto max-h-[32rem] scroll-smooth motion-reduce:scroll-auto`. Row entrance: `motion-safe:animate-slide-up` with inline `style={{ animationDelay: \`${index * 40}ms\` }}`.

Edit src/components/LoadingSteps.tsx (keep `applyStreamEvent`, `INITIAL_PROGRESS`, `QueryProgress`, `StepStatus`, `stepsFor`, `StepIcon`, `active` derivation, `aria-live` region verbatim). Add `motion-safe:animate-slide-up` and `shadow-[var(--shadow-glass-xl)]` to the outer card. On the progress-line fill, add a sheen overlay via `after:absolute after:inset-0 after:bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,0.5),transparent)] motion-safe:after:animate-sheen`. In the elapsed-timer pill, add a leading dot with `motion-safe:animate-pulse-dot`.

Edit src/components/ZoneDetails.tsx (keep `cell`, `scoredCells`, `weights`, `onSelectTop`, `isProposed`, `onToggleProposal`, `rawLabel`, `COMPONENT_LABELS`, `priorityBand`, `SCENARIO_RADIUS_METERS`, `FACILITY_RADIUS_METERS` verbatim). Replace the existing `h-14 w-14` score square with an inline `<svg viewBox="0 0 36 36">` radial meter: 1 track `<circle>` with `stroke-[#e7ece1]`, 1 foreground arc with `stroke-dasharray` = (2π·r) and `stroke-dashoffset` = `(100 - cell.score) / 100 * (2π·r)`; arc color = `priorityBand(cell.priority).color`; centered `<text>` for the score (dash for `unscored`). Keep the component bars' `role="meter"` and all `aria-*` attributes; swap the fill to `bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--green)] to-[var(--lime)]` over a `bg-[#e7ece1]/60 backdrop-blur-sm` track. Make the 'Propose a 150 m greening cluster here' CTA prominent (`relative overflow-hidden`), add a `before:` pseudo-element running `motion-safe:animate-sheen` on hover. Keep `aria-pressed={isProposed}` and the toggle label swap. Add `motion-safe:animate-fade-in` on the whole section.

Edit src/components/ImpactComparison.tsx (keep `scenario`, `cellId`, `facilities`, `onClear`, `limit=6`, the reduced-motion-aware `useEffect` + `scrollIntoView`, `BEFORE_COLOR` / `AFTER_COLOR`, `percent`, the `cellChanges.slice(0, limit)` list, and the `reached` filter verbatim). The three summary stat tiles each get a thin gradient accent and `motion-safe:animate-pop-in` keyed on `cellId`. Dumbbell chart rows stagger entrance via inline `style={{ animationDelay: \`${i * 60}ms\` }}` + `motion-safe:animate-slide-up`. Swap the Clear button to an icon-button variant (× glyph + 'Clear' text) at the top-right.

Edit src/components/ExploreGuide.tsx (keep `steps` derivation from `hasSelection` / `hasProposal`, `current` index, and the `SCENARIO_RADIUS_METERS` reference verbatim). Replace the solid dark card with `rounded-[28px] bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--green-dark)] to-[#0b2a1b] text-white shadow-[var(--shadow-glass-xl)]`. Apply `.animate-gradient-shift` to a `::before` background mask via `relative overflow-hidden` and a pseudo-element div. Each `<li>` keeps its `aria-current` semantics.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` both exit 0 from the repo root.
Dashboard.tsx root element is `<div>`, not `<main>`; the inline <header> block is gone.
The module-scope `subscribe` and `getSnapshot` for `useIsDesktop` are declared at module scope, not inside Dashboard's body (iteration-3 NIT #5).
Dashboard holds `hoveredCellId` state and threads it to <MapView> through <MapShell>; <PriorityPanel> receives both `hoveredCellId` and `onHoverCell` props.
MapView.tsx defines a module-level `PRIORITY_CHROME_HEX` constant and a `groupedChrome` helper; the hovered-cell polygon is `interactive: false` and only renders when hovered !== selected.
PriorityPanel.tsx renders a filter/sort toolbar using two <SegmentedControl> instances; the authoritative score-chip color still comes from `priorityBand(cell.priority).color`.
The Skeleton helper applies `bg-[#e3eadf] animate-shimmer` (no `motion-safe:` prefix) so reduced-motion users still see a solid block (iteration-2 HIGH #1).
`git diff --stat src/lib src/types src/app/api` reports zero changes.
verification: cd "c:\\Users\\Daniyal\\Desktop\\New folder\\Alethiea" ; npm run typecheck ; npm run lint

Browser smoke at 1440px: /explore renders with the new metric cards, floating LayerDock over the map, polished LoadingSteps during streaming, StatusPill in Header transitions streaming → ready, cell click opens ZoneDetails with the radial meter, 'Propose 150 m' creates a scenario and ImpactComparison renders, PriorityPanel hover produces a dashed outline on the matching map polygon, Change area in Header returns to '/' and the pill resets to idle.
git diff --stat src/lib src/types src/app/api — zero changes.
